name: LoveSpark Dashboard
short_description: Central command center for the LoveSpark suite — manage all your retro pink productivity extensions in one place.
detailed_description:
LoveSpark Dashboard is the home base for the LoveSpark suite of free, open-source extensions built for neurodivergent coders.

FEATURES
• See every installed LoveSpark extension at a glance
• Toggle extensions on/off without digging through chrome://extensions
• Quick links to settings, support, and the GitHub repos
• Retro pink aesthetic with 4 themes (retro, dark, beige, slate)
• Sparky mascot keeps you company while you work

PRIVACY
• No tracking. No analytics. No data collection. Ever.
• Storage is local-only — nothing leaves your browser
• MIT licensed and fully open source

Who it's for: Anyone using the LoveSpark productivity suite who wants a single hub instead of jumping between extension popups.
single_purpose: Provide a unified hub to view, toggle, and configure LoveSpark suite extensions.

permissions_justification.management: Required to enumerate and toggle other LoveSpark extensions installed in the browser.
permissions_justification.tabs: Required to open extension settings pages and the LoveSpark hub from the dashboard.
